definitions.explanation: An artistic technique for creating the illusion of depth and distance on a flat surface.

examples.japanese: {遠近法|えんきんほう}を{使|つか}って{描|えが}く。
この{絵|え}は{遠近法|えんきんほう}が{正|ただ}しくない。
examples.english: The perspective in this painting is not correct.

examples.japanese: ルネサンス{期|き}に{遠近法|えんきんほう}の{技法|ぎほう}が{大|おお}きく{発展|はってん}した。
examples.english: Perspective techniques developed greatly during the Renaissance.

notes:
A technique in art for representing three-dimensional space on a flat surface, creating the illusion of depth. The word combines {遠近|えんきん} (far and near; distance) and {法|ほう} (method/technique).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遠近法|えんきんほう}を{使|つか}う: to use perspective
- {遠近法|えんきんほう}の{技法|ぎほう}: perspective technique
- {一点|いってん}{透視|とうし}{遠近法|えんきんほう}: one-point perspective
- {空気|くうき}{遠近法|えんきんほう}: atmospheric perspective

RELATED WORDS:
- {消失点|しょうしつてん}: vanishing point
- {構図|こうず}: composition (in art)
- {奥行|おくゆ}き: depth; sense of distance
